findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "reports" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: astroway_reports_history · Private data: astroway_account_status, astroway_agent_tools, astroway_reports_ai_natal_narrative, astroway_reports_gemstone, astroway_whitelabel_domain_verify, astroway_whitelabel_logo · Public sink: astroway_mcp_ai_chat, astroway_reports_gemstone, astroway_whitelabel_logo · Destructive: astroway_account_status, astroway_agent_tools, astroway_mcp_multi_agent_coordinate, astroway_reports_gemstone, astroway_reports_natal, astroway_reports_relocation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: astroway_reports_history · Private data: astroway_account_status, astroway_agent_tools, astroway_reports_ai_natal_narrative, astroway_reports_gemstone, astroway_whitelabel_domain_verify, astroway_whitelabel_logo · Public sink: astroway_mcp_ai_chat, astroway_reports_gemstone, astroway_whitelabel_logo · Destructive: astroway_account_status, astroway_agent_tools, astroway_mcp_multi_agent_coordinate, astroway_reports_gemstone, astroway_reports_natal, astroway_reports_relocation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
